disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or deceit in obtaining a certificate as a CPA or permit to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud or deceit in obtaining a certificate as a certified public accountant or in obtaining a permit to practice public accounting under this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dishonesty, fraud or gross negligence in practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dishonesty, fraud or gross negligence by a certified public accountant or a natural person or certified public accounting firm granted practice privileges pursuant to NRS 628.315.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any provision of NRS Chapter 628
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any of the provisions of this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of a Board regulation or rule of professional conduct
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of a regulation or rule of professional conduct adopted by the Board under the authority granted by this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony relating to the practice of public accounting
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony relating to the practice of public accounting under the laws of any state or jurisdiction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of any crime involving dishonesty, fraud, or moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of any crime: An element of which is dishonesty or fraud; or Involving moral turpitude, under the laws of any state or jurisdiction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Cancellation, revocation, suspension, probation or refusal to renew authority to practice as CPA in another state
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Cancellation, revocation, suspension, placing on probation or refusal to renew authority to practice as a certified public accountant by any other state, for any cause.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Suspension, revocation or probation of right to practice before any state or federal agency
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Suspension, revocation or placing on probation of the right to practice before any state or federal agency.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to obtain an annual permit within 60 days of expiration (unless excused by Board)
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unless the person has been placed on inactive or retired status, failure to obtain an annual permit under NRS 628.380, within: Sixty days after the expiration date of the permit to practice last obtained or renewed by the holder of a certificate

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conduct discreditable to the profession of public accounting or reflecting adversely on fitness to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conduct discreditable to the profession of public accounting or which reflects adversely upon the fitness of the person to engage in the practice of public accounting.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making a false or misleading statement in support of another person's application
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making a false or misleading statement in support of an application for a certificate or permit of another person.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing an act in another state that would be subject to discipline there
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing an act in another state or jurisdiction which would be subject to discipline in that state.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: Each office established or maintained in this State for the practice of public accounting in this State by a certified public accountant or a partnership, corporation or limited-liability company composed of certified public accountants must be registered annually under this chapter with the Board.

definition_quote.value: "Practice of public accounting" means the offering to perform or the performance by a holder of a live permit or a natural person or certified public accounting firm granted practice privileges pursuant to NRS 628.315, for a client or potential client, of one or more services involving the use of skills in accounting or auditing, one or more services relating to advising or consulting with clients on matters relating to management or the preparation of tax returns and the furnishing of advice on matters relating to taxes.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of public accounting" means the offering to perform or the performance by a holder of a live permit or a natural person or certified public accounting firm granted practice privileges pursuant to NRS 628.315, for a client or potential client, of one or more services involving the use of skills in accounting or auditing, one or more services relating to advising or consulting with clients on matters relating to management or the preparation of tax returns and the furnishing of advice on matters relating to taxes.

attest_services_types.quote: "Attest," "attesting" and "attestation" mean providing the following services: 1. An audit or other engagement to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Auditing Standards (SAS) ... 2. A review of a financial statement to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Accounting and Review Services (SSARS) ... 3. An examination of prospective financial information to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Attestation Engagements (SSAE) ... 4. An engagement to be performed in accordance with the standards of the Public Company Accounting Oversight Board. 5. An examination, review or agreed upon procedures engagement to be performed in accordance with the SSAE, other than an examination described in subsection 3.

compilation_services_authorized.quote: "Compilation" means providing a service to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Accounting and Review Services (SSARS) published by the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants, that is presented in the form of financial statements, of information that is the representation of the owner or management without undertaking to express any assurance on the statements.

practice_privilege_no_notice_required.quote: A natural person or certified public accounting firm granted practice privileges pursuant to subsection 1 is not required to obtain, as applicable: (a) A certificate pursuant to NRS 628.190; (b) A permit pursuant to NRS 628.380; or (c) A registration pursuant to NRS 628.335.

practice_privilege_consent_conditions.quote: A natural person granted practice privileges pursuant to subsection 1 ... shall be deemed to consent, as a condition of the grant of such practice privileges: (a) To the personal and subject matter jurisdiction, and disciplinary authority, of the Board. (c) That, in the event that the license or registration from the state wherein the principal place of business of the natural person or certified public accounting firm is located becomes invalid or not in good standing ... (d) To the appointment of the state board that issued the license or registration as the agent upon whom process may be served

firm_majority_cpa_ownership_required.quote: a simple majority of the ownership of a corporation, partnership or limited-liability company organized for the practice of public accounting in this State, in terms of the financial interests and voting rights of all shareholders, partners, officers, members and principals thereof, must belong to persons who are certified public accountants in any state.

nonlicensee_firm_owners_permitted.quote: A corporation, partnership or limited-liability company organized for the practice of public accounting in this State may have as a shareholder, partner, officer, member or principal any natural person who is not a certified public accountant in any state if: (a) The natural person is actively engaged in the business of the corporation, partnership or limited-liability company, or any affiliate thereof; and (b) The corporation, partnership or limited-liability company complies with any other requirements that the Board by regulation may impose.

office_supervision_by_licensed_cpa_requi.quote: Each manager in charge of an office of the partnership in this State must be a certified public accountant of this State in good standing.

attest_report_signer_competency_requirem.quote: A person who, on his or her own behalf or on behalf of a partnership, corporation, limited-liability company or sole proprietorship, signs or authorizes another to sign an accountant's report on financial statements shall meet the requirements for competency as set forth in the professional standards of accounting.

working_papers_ownership_by_licensee.quote: All statements, records, schedules, working papers and memoranda made by a certified public accountant or a natural person or certified public accounting firm granted practice privileges pursuant to NRS 628.315 incident to or in the course of professional service to clients by the accountant, except reports submitted by a certified public accountant or a natural person or certified public accounting firm granted practice privileges pursuant to NRS 628.315 to a client, are the property of the accountant, in the absence of an express agreement between the accountant and the client to the contrary.

safe_harbor_disclaimer_language_for_nonl.quote: Any person who does not hold a live permit from preparing a financial statement or issuing a report if the statement or report, respectively, includes a disclosure that: (1) The person who prepared the statement or issued the report does not hold a live permit issued by the Board; and (2) The statement or report does not purport to have been prepared in compliance with the professional standards of accounting adopted by the Board.
